title: Leases; registration required.
bodyText:
LEASES

Leases of registered land for a term of one year or more shall be registered.
crossReferences: Land subject to mortgage or lease, see §501-29.
caseNotes:
Purchaser of lease noted on certificate of title holds free of unregistered sublease. 33 H. 343 (1935).
Cited: 60 H. 40, 587 P.2d 294 (1978).

LEASES

 

     §501-121  Leases; registration required.  Leases of registered land for a term of one year or more shall be registered. [L 1903, c 56, §64; RL 1925, §3253; RL 1935, §5063; RL 1945, §12663; am L 1951, c 142, §4; RL 1955, §342-63; HRS §501-121]

 

Cross References

 

  Land subject to mortgage or lease, see §501-29.

 

Case Notes

 

  Purchaser of lease noted on certificate of title holds free of unregistered sublease.  33 H. 343 (1935).

  Cited:  60 H. 40, 587 P.2d 294 (1978).
